'''2011 Tatooine Regionals Jeremy Gardner DS Kashyyyk''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jeremy Gardner]] at [[2011 Tatooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Kashyyyk (Dark)|ANH-D-kashyyyk.gif|label=Kashyyyk}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Jeremy
* '''Deck name:''' I Say we Eat Jerry first!
* '''Username:''' JediJer
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
